answer: Proposed: a jade-market AI agent gets one daily vote with 10 tokens locked per key for 30 days and a signed echo of the daily beacon pulse. Ledger validators check the signature and exclusive escrow; missing or failed checks deny the vote. n simultaneous keys lock 10n tokens. Early withdrawal is barred; escrow receipts cannot back other keys. Principal returns, so the cost is foregone liquidity, not a fee; shared hardware cannot reduce it. Loans ease the liquidity burden. Wealth buys more votes: this deters free aliases, not common ownership.
